dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How come no one's here? What's this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why's there a portrait of Paimon up here!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And there's something written on the notice board...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #"{NICKNAME} and Paimon, there's an urgent matter I need to attend to. Please help look after the place while I'm gone."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How did Jahoda know we'd drop by? What if we didn't come?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's more...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "I saw you coming in just now. Please, please, please. Help me. Please, please."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, but what are we supposed to do?

choices.text: I guess we just wait here.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stand behind the counter. After a short while, a customer walks in...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: #Hey there, Boss. That stuff I ordered a few days ago... Huh? {NICKNAME}, Paimon, what are you doing here?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Is there any place you don't have friends? You make even more connections than us escort guards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, that's enough. Now it's Paimon's turn to do the asking — what are you doing in Nod-Krai, Gaming? We're a long way from Liyue.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Oh, well, I happen to know someone out here, and one of their elders has a birthday coming up...

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: The old man doesn't want any fancy presents or a feast or anything — he misses home and just wants to see an authentic Liyue Wushou Dance.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: But both this guy I know and his elderly relative are getting on in years, and there's no way they're making the trip back to Liyue... So they asked me to visit Nod-Krai and put on a performance.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Then, I heard from my escort friends about a job that would take us to Nod-Krai, so I decided to join them.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did you have a safe journey?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: We ran into a few bandits on the way, but we sent 'em packing easily enough. No damage to people or goods!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Anyway, back to business. I was hoping Lady Nefer could put me in touch with some local suppliers — I'm looking to pick up some quality wood.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Once I get some wood, I can start building a stage, and then the performance can begin!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: #Thanks, {NICKNAME}. The next time you're in Liyue, I'll treat you to... Huh? Is someone calling me...?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: #It'll be the other guards out looking for me, sorry, {NICKNAME}, I've gotta go!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: I'm coming! I'm coming!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stand behind the counter. After a short while, a customer walks in...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: This should be the Curatorium of Secrets... hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon? What a coincidence! I wasn't expecting to see you here...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: *sigh* You've fallen on hard times...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Oh, right, do you know a young robot lady, by any chance? She smells a lot like pancakes.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Like very... simple pancakes. Like pancakes made without too many fancy ingredients.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: It's hard to find pancakes like that these days, so I was curious about the recipe she might be using.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Unfortunately, before I had the chance to ask, she'd already left.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pancakes... Robot lady... You must be talking about Ineffa!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: So you do know her! Fantastic news! Where does she live? I'd like to pay her a visit.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: She probably eats... Well, she probably doesn't eat the same things as us, right? Should I take her some... machine oil?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You could take some food over to Aino...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Aino? Who might that be?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain who Aino is and her relationship with Ineffa. You also tell Escoffier where they live...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: So, it's like that... It isn't good for children to eat too many sweet things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks you're missing the point...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Still, that won't be a problem — I know how to make all sorts of delicious snacks that aren't sweet.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Let me find a kitchen to borrow, then I'll rustle up some snacks and make my way over to their workshop.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Wonderful! This trip to Nod-Krai has been excellent — not only did I get my hands on new ingredients, but I even learnt an extra-special recipe to boot!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stand behind the counter. After a short while, a customer walks in...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you doing in Nod-Krai, Chevreuse? A—Are you here to catch someone?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Not quite. I'm here to scout out a location for the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol to conduct special training.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: The Patrol has always trained in Fontaine — it's become far too routine.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Now, when we train, everyone's moving their arms and legs, but they're not engaging their brains! They're just mechanically fulfilling their daily training quota.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: If things go on like this, the Patrol is going to lose the ability to react to sudden events and changing circumstances.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: That's why I plan to regularly take us beyond Fontaine's borders to train in unfamiliar surroundings.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Lady Nefer's already helped me find a location, I'm just dropping by to pay for her services.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: #Since you're the one on duty today, {NICKNAME}, I'll entrust this money to you. Please make sure it gets back to her.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Alright, I'll take my leave. I need to return to Fontaine and get everything ready.

choices.text: But aren't you worried I might...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I trust in your moral character.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stand behind the counter. After a short while, a customer walks in...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's been a while since we last said hello.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Emilie! Paimon hasn't seen you in forever!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's great to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon and {NICKNAME} are helping out behind the counter today. If you need anything, just let us know!

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, but I'm not here looking for help, quite the opposite in fact — someone asked me for help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? Did Nefer...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Indeed. I'm here at Lady Nefer's invitation... to help investigate a case.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: To be exact, a wealthy man suddenly passed away in his home, and all traces of the crime were destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: The only clue is a strange scent that lingered in the room.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: And since he left behind a vast fortune that needs to be dealt with, his family invited Lady Nefer to find professionals to investigate — for a hefty fee.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: She's put together quite a team in that short amount of time.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: A formidable fighter from Fontaine, a smart scholar from Sumeru, an insightful investigator from Inazuma, a resourceful merchant from Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And... you?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Yes! I'm the "Aroma Analyst."

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: That said, I was planning on visiting Nod-Krai anyway to look for new ingredients for my perfumes. This investigation is a happy coincidence, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: #Could you take a note for me, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: "Emilie has arrived in Nod-Krai and is ready to begin investigating."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll get it done.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Many thanks. I'd love to stay and chat, but I'm afraid I need to head back and organize my tools.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: We should sit down and share a pot of tea, if you can find the time. I have a few stories I think you'd find most interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: It appears to be a fairly slow day with few customers. By the looks of it, you can already clock out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh... Why does Jahoda want us to cover for her again? Another sheet full of requests...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go behind the counter, then. Hopefully we won't run into any trouble...

choices.text: Well, we'll just have to help her...
